blocks.text:
In the morning, visit the National Museum of Archaeology and Ethnology, home to a large collection of Maya artefacts.

Then travel to Copán Ruinas in Honduras. This day marks a transition from modern cities and living traditions to one of the journey’s main archaeological sites. After exploring Maya objects at the museum in Guatemala City, you can see them in context among the ruins and carved stelae of Copán.

**Hotel:** Clarion Copan Ruinas.  
**Meals:** breakfast.
